Clara application screenshots — Agents, Workflows, and Autonomy refresh
Captured for the website update on 13 November 2026 (user task date).

Source: the running Clara Phoenix application at http://127.0.0.1:4000.
The adjacent app checkout was at commit 3dbe94ad during capture; the running
process's exact build revision was not independently verified. The current UI
was inspected directly and shows separate Agents and Workflows navigation.

Chromium, 1440 x 1000 CSS pixels, light theme, device scale factor 1.
All captures use the existing fictional fieldnotes-bloom-demo workspace and
its demo account. No personal workspace or real customer content is shown.

agents.png: /fieldnotes-bloom-demo/agents/library — the current Agent library,
including each role and its jobs.
workflows.png (refreshed 14 November 2026): the actual Workflows canvas at
/fieldnotes-bloom-demo/workflows/65b7515a-a759-405b-b6a6-db5afbf39526?tab=design.
Captured at 1920 x 1100. A dedicated fictional "Fieldnotes · Release to
campaign" standalone draft was created through Clara's normal UI, with seven
nodes and seven connections: Trigger → Research & angle → two Generate
content branches → individual Human review steps → Notify team. This is the
full editor with its Workflow tab, canvas controls, and node properties, not
an agent template preview. The workflow was saved but never activated or run.

chat.png (added 14 November 2026): /fieldnotes-bloom-demo/home — actual chat
composer with a fictional Fieldnotes launch brief entered but not sent.

autonomy.png: /organizations/fieldnotes-bloom-demo/settings/autonomy — the
three presets, pause control, and per-action settings. Existing Co-pilot
selection preserved; no autonomy settings were changed.
brand.png: /fieldnotes-bloom-demo/brand — existing fictional brand guidelines.
plays.png: /fieldnotes-bloom-demo/plays — current content-play catalog.
linkedin.png: the real LinkedIn play dialog with an illustrative Fieldnotes
brief entered. The play was not submitted.

Screenshots were taken directly with Playwright. No DOM substitutions or
image edits were used. No agents were created or activated, no workflows were
run, and no content was generated or published. One standalone demonstration
workflow was created and saved as an inactive draft for the canvas capture.
Existing workspace settings and brand content were not modified. Credentials and browser state are not
included in the website.
